calls.title: Purple<>GrowthBook - Product Analytics Demo
calls.summary: GrowthBook (Logan Bates) demoed its product analytics capabilities, including funnel analysis, user journey, and AI analyst features, to Purple (Ishan Supanekar and Ashley Seguin), who seek to consolidate A/B testing and analytics tools while ensuring repeatable dashboards and error tracking. Key pain points included data governance and custom metric definitions
